This case goes to ops as a hand-off, not to the coder.

The get-order request failed because `/app/data/orders.csv` was not found when the repository was built. The investigator traced it to the constructor in `src/OrderService/Orders.cs` line 22 (`File.ReadLines(csvPath)`), with high confidence. The path is relative and resolves against the working directory, which was `/app` in this deploy. The data file exists in the repo but is missing from that deployed location. This matches the runbook row "the data file, `data/orders.csv`, missing or unreadable, or where it is deployed", which gives hand-off to ops. I checked the run record before deciding, and it matches the investigator's report.

I have not recorded a `RaiseToPerson`, since the hand-off ends the run with the ops department.
